chosenApproach: Reconcile already reviewed narrow source patches on clean main; keep backend and native runtime byte-identical; protect changed files with a single exact cumulative work scope and the existing protected-feature lock, GitHub source CI and independently verified EAS staging then production gates. Forward-port the exact six source/test blobs of QA-passed PR #982 into Wave1 candidate without its standalone manifest; track delta in this one cumulative RC scope.

Skip staging/cost/ad gating and push directly to production (rejected, violates agreed release and no-charge safety).
Rewrite Connect scroll/pagination and make ads interrupt each comment (rejected, regression and monetization risks).
selectionRationale: Only four non-Season2 existing approved UI/Ad improvements; source-only, no live changes, exact gate/preservation evidence. Shared first-view NativeAd failure memory and correctly sized BannerAd loading target the live callback timeout/no-fill gap, not any Season2 economy change.

Wall post/video/photos, route privacy and reaction data ownership remain intact; interstitial opportunity is optional and never blocks publishing comments.

Manual history swipes, latest/older page offsets, read receipts, GIF/photo/file and PTT/calls remain accessible and correctly scoped.

Preserve canonical AdMob test/live IDs, user consent, SDK-authored impressions, cooldown, protected routes, focused dashboard priority and no offscreen ad rendering.
Keep Android first-view NativeAd timeout bounded at 9 seconds while preserving 12-second feed timeout for slow mobile networks; no parallel request storms.
acceptanceChecks: First five successful comments per Manila day are ad-free; sixth and every fifth extra success queue at most one optional interstitial on next editor close.
Post detail and photo-comment close consume pending ad once; no ad during text input, RPC submission, or for failed/duplicate submissions.
Global Android safety controller still enforces two distinct eligible actions, interaction locks, route restrictions, AdMob consent, Ad-Light and remote flags.
AdMob decides the actual interstitial creative (video or static); do not promise or fabricate a video creative or impression.
Existing Community Wall, scoped Community, post detail, photo comments, media playback, first-view ad and instant dashboard navigation regression suite must pass.
Only source-level readback passed so far; focused Node test, TypeScript/Android compile and served staging OTA identity require independent verification.
Never update main, production channel, production APK, Play release or Supabase database in this PR. Season2 rewards remain off until independently approved after December 6.
